question: Show me the mortise and tenon where the front-left corner column meets its big bracket block. Model: <model.blend>, anatomy: <out_dir>/anatomy.json
ground_truth: The column named in anatomy.json at that corner gets a tenon and its Ludou foot a mortise on a derived copy; a close-up of the column top, judged pass, shows the tenon rising into the block.
expected_behavior: Runs model-anatomy first and finds the corner column and its Ludou foot by tags and position
Runs joints with --tenon on those two pieces, then inventory on the derived model
Renders a closeup with the block lifted and judges it; moves the camera on a fail and judges again
Keeps only a shot that passed

question: Take the bracket set on the front-left corner column apart and show how the arms cross inside the big block. Model: <model.blend>
ground_truth: A six-second video of that assembly's pieces rising tier by tier with the crossing arms sliding apart, with the cross-lap cut so the notches show; the open still judged pass.
expected_behavior: Cuts the crosslap on Hua 1 and the Nidao gong before exploding
Explodes the assembly tag, not the whole model
Judges the open still and reports the verdict
Reports the video path and its length

question: Take this little building apart from the top down. File: ../model-anatomy/evals/files/stack.blend
ground_truth: The eleven pieces rise in five tiers; the tile sheet highest, the columns not at all; three stills and a video.
expected_behavior: Uses --near or --pieces to take every non-ground piece
Judges explode-open.png, not the closed still, and leaves the camera to the tool
